Using Theorem 10.4 one can also generalize the proof of Lemma 5.11: the functors $\mathsf{F}_{\lambda}$ do not depend on the choice of Torel $T\subset B$ , up to canonical isomorphism.

Below we will also need the following claim (where, as in §6.2, we denote by $D^{\mathrm{b}}_{c,{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ the constructible ${G_{\mathcal{O}}}$ -equivariant derived category).
card.label: Remark 10.5

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
